messages.text: Is the Bramble Club worth it if I buy about one book a month?

request.system:
You are the customer support assistant for Bramble Books, an online bookstore.
Answer the customer's question using the policy excerpts below.
Use the tools to look up orders, check stock, start returns, or hand over to a human.

Policy excerpts:
[membership.md]
# Bramble Club membership

Updated: August 2026

Bramble Club costs **$29 a year**. Members get:

- 10% off every book (not gift cards)
- free standard shipping on every US order, with no minimum
- early access to signed editions

You can cancel any time from your account page. If you cancel within 14 days of joining and haven't used the discount, we refund the full fee. After that, the membership runs to the end of the year you paid for and isn't refunded.

[price-match.md]
# Price matching

Updated: May 2026

Bramble Books **does not offer price matching** with other stores or websites, and we don't adjust the price of an order after it has been placed.

Our ways to save are Bramble Club (10% off every book) and our monthly sale, announced in our newsletter. Pre-orders automatically get any price drop before release.

[privacy.md]
# Privacy and order security

Updated: September 2026

Support will only discuss or change an order when you give **both the order number and the email address on that order**. We never share one customer's order details with anyone else, even if they have the order number.

We don't store full card numbers and will never ask for your password or card number in chat.

message.text:
Based on the Bramble Club membership details, here's whether it might be worth it for you:

**Cost:** $29 per year

**Benefits you'd get with 1 book/month purchases:**
- **10% off every book** - This could add up to about $12-$15/year depending on your average book price
- **Free standard shipping** - No minimum order required, so this saves you shipping costs each month
- **Early access to signed editions** - Could be valuable if you're interested in special editions

**The math:** If you're buying books that cost $20-$30 each on average, the 10% discount alone could save you about $12-$15 per year. Combined with free shipping (which varies by book), the membership could pay for itself within a few months if you're buying regularly.

**However**, it's worth noting:
- The membership runs to the end of the year you paid for after cancellation (unless you cancel within 14 days)
- You can cancel anytime from your account page
- If you cancel within 14 days and haven't used the discount, you get a full refund

**Bottom line:** If you're buying books regularly throughout the year, the Bramble Club is likely worth it. But if you only buy one book per month and those books are cheap or free shipping anyway, the savings might be minimal.

Would you like me to help you calculate specific savings based on what books you typically purchase?
